pit.convention: midrank empirical CDF; ties receive half mass

standardized_residual.convention: (posterior mean - truth) / empirical posterior std; zero-variance coordinates are counted separately; Gaussian reference is descriptive only

definitions.rmse: Mean over test windows of sqrt(mean squared error over future times and states)
definitions.posterior_median_rmse: Same mean-window RMSE convention using the coordinatewise posterior median, provided as an outlier-sensitivity diagnostic
definitions.maximum_absolute_posterior: Maximum absolute draw coordinate in metric space, before any plot scaling or clipping
definitions.maximum_absolute_posterior_normalized: Maximum absolute draw coordinate in the original normalized archive space
definitions.pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean squared posterior-mean error over all windows, future times and states)
definitions.crps: Exact empirical marginal CRPS, averaged over windows, future times and states
definitions.energy_score: Empirical energy score of each D-dimensional future state; exact first term and exact condensed all-pairs term
definitions.energy_score_mc_se: Zero for exact pair integration; otherwise Monte Carlo pair-integration standard error of the run mean, not test-set or training-seed variability
definitions.coverage_90: Inclusive central empirical 5th–95th percentile interval coverage
definitions.interval_score_90: Width + 20*(lower-truth) for lower misses + 20*(truth-upper) for upper misses
definitions.calibration_mae: Mean absolute central-interval coverage error over the reported nominal levels
definitions.predictive_std: Population standard deviation of the empirical posterior (ddof=0)
definitions.reliability: Equal-count bins by predicted std; compare sqrt(mean predictive variance) against sqrt(mean posterior-mean squared error)
definitions.per_dimension_rmse: Pooled RMSE within each state dimension
definitions.uncertainty_scope: Marginal future-state uncertainty; no score assumes coherent posterior trajectories
